meta.name: Puzzle 05 — Silence at Range
meta.description: SOLO PUZZLE. A Blinker oscillates far across the dish. Goal: destroy it in 1 move using a Glider launched from the opposite corner. Teaches that named Conway tools combine: a glider (spaceship, known behavior) destroys a blinker (oscillator, known behavior) from across the map. Feels like a long-range strike — the ultimate demonstration of 'deploy don't predict'.
meta.rules: Solo mode. Prompt: 'Destroy the specimen from across the dish in 1 move.' Win check: 0 live cells at end (or very little debris, < 5).
questions: Does the 'long-range strike' feel land as a climactic puzzle?
Is the glider's trajectory clear enough that the player can aim by eye?
Are 4–5 advance presses okay, or does that feel like too much waiting?

moves.note: Player launches a glider from the NW corner. It will travel ~5 diagonal cells before reaching the blinker.
